This update introduces two new mechanics for each hero: Innate abilities and Facets
Innate Abilities
Innates are abilities that are present on the hero for the entire game, from the very beginning of e
The Innate for each hero can be viewed on the Hero page, or in-game by hovering a new icon between t
There are two types of Innates:
Some Innates grant a hero a unique effect. For example, Faceless Void slows enemy attack projectiles
Some Innates change a hero ability to have five levels and get a free ability point at level 1. For
Facets
Facets are a hero customization choice that provide the ability to better align the playstyle of a h
Hero Facets can be viewed on their hero page, below the hero name and tags. They can also be viewed
Facets are set for all players after the strategy time, and cannot be changed during a match. Facet
Facets can have a variety of effects, for example:
Viper can choose between adding an AoE damage burst to Poison Attack, or increasing defensive buffs
Wraith King can choose between summoning skeletons, or dealing additional curse damage when attackin
Leshrac can choose between his attacks restoring mana, or changing Diabolic Edict to explode faster
Lone Druid can choose between an improved Spirit Link, granting lifesteal in both directions, or all

When available, fully clearing a Neutral Creep Camp provides the player with Madstone
Collecting enough Madstone allows the player to craft a Neutral Item by selecting one Artifact and o

Dropped Madstone is automatically collected if there are no enemy heroes within an 800 unit radius o
If the player who collects the Madstone is already at their limit (more info below), all of their Ma
Neutral Items are now composed of two parts: Artifacts & Enchantments
Artifacts are the ability of the item and can be passive and/or active
Enchantments provide passive stats and attributes to items
Similar to the previous Neutral Item System, items are arranged by Tiers
Each Tier is only available past a specific point in time
Each Artifact belongs to a single tier
Enchantments have multiple levels and can be found in multiple tiers
When crafting, players are given a choice of 4 Artifacts and 4 Enchantments and choose one of each
Artifacts will provide 3 options from the current tier and the last option will be to keep the curre
Enchantments will provide 4 options from the current tier with no option to keep the current Enchant
Crafting a Neutral Item replaces the existing Neutral Item, if there is one
Players must craft a Tier 1 Neutral Item before they can craft a Tier 2 Neutral Item
Crafting a Tier 1 Neutral Item takes 5 Madstone
Crafting Tier 2, 3, 4, or 5 Neutral Items takes 10 Madstone
Tier 5 Neutral Items can be recrafted for an escalating 10 Madstone cost
Players are limited in the amount of Madstone they can obtain at any given point in time
At specific intervals, the limit will increase enough to allow players to craft the next Tier of Neu
At the start of the game, the Madstone Cap is 0
At 5:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 5
At 15:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 15
At 25:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 25
At 35:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 35
At 60:00, the Madstone Cap is increased to 45
At 70:00, the Madstone Cap is removed and players can collect infinite Madstone
Madstone Availability times are halved in Turbo
Collecting Madstone results in 3 Madstone for the player and 2 for their team
